data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Hello. This is a known UI display bug that is currently affecting several accounts, though your actual user permissions remain fully intact. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user profile in the admin console, change their role to something else, save it, and then change it back to the correct role. A permanent patch for this display issue will be released shortly. [T-758] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
